record.name: Mercenary Soldier
record.description: Mercenary Soldiers are disciplined professionals who coordinate allies, execute fire-and-maneuver tactics, and turn chaos into calculated advantage.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a defensive stance, feet shoulder-width apart, with the blaster rifle at the ready and eyes scanning the surroundings for any signs of danger.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A faint hum of blue energy emanates from the character's suit, indicating a stabilizer pack that helps to manage their life support systems.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A rugged and weathered mercenary soldier, clad in worn Stormtrooper armor, with a blaster rifle slung over their shoulder, standing on a dusty desert planet surrounded by sand-covered rocks and twisted metal debris.
contextual_modifiers: Include a faint smoke trail behind the character
Add a small, sleek speeder bike parked in the distance, its engines still warm from recent use

progression_tree.description: You learn to direct your allies' attacks, creating opportunities for yourself and others. When you are not the leader of a group, you can use your bonus action to take the initiative.
You become more precise in combat, increasing your ability to hit and deal damage. Your attack rolls have advantage when you are not the leader of a group.

effects.notes: The mercenary soldier locks onto their target with pinpoint accuracy, gaining a +1 bonus to attack rolls. The precision focus is so intense that it momentarily distracts the soldier from the surrounding environment.

progression_tree.description: You can enter a state of focus during combat, increasing your resilience and ability to deal damage. While focused, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws.

effects.notes: As a battle-hardened mercenary, you momentarily focus your combat instincts upon landing a hit. For a brief instant, your reflexes are heightened, and your senses are amplified.

progression_tree.description: You become more skilled at controlling the battlefield, granting you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and allowing you to use your bonus action to make a melee attack.

effects.notes: Your battlefield prowess is sharpened in combat, granting you a +1 bonus to hit enemies while they are within 10 feet of you.

progression_tree.description: You learn to manage chaos on the battlefield, granting you advantage on all Charisma checks and allowing you to use your action to calm a frightened ally.

effects.notes: The mercenary Soldier's battle-hardened instincts kick in, swiftly assessing the situation and adapting their tactics to mitigate damage. They gain +1 advantage on next action.
